rows.quote: - Mrs. Barbara Patch retired from her Middle School teaching in June of 1979 after sixteen years of dedicated service to the school system. Barbara taught many different disciplines and many different grade levels during her tenure. We all wish her much happiness in the years ahead.
rows.note: Heading of a narrative or list entry as printed; the quote is the first lines of the entry.

rows.quote: - Mrs. Alma Kilpatrick is retiring on February 1, 1980 after fifteen years of dedicated service to the school system. It is with regret that we accept her resignation because of her teaching ability and understanding of children. Alma is moving to Maine because of her love for the ocean. May her retirement years be filled with happiness.
rows.note: Heading of a narrative or list entry as printed; the quote is the first lines of the entry.

rows.quote: - Mrs. Anne Styrna retired in June of 1979 after serving as a clerk/typist at the Middle School for eight years and three and one-half months. Anne was a very jovial person with students and faculty and always willing to help people with their problems. rows.quote: ISABELLE L. KARL - In September 1966, Isabelle was appointed as a grade 4 teacher in the Elementary Annex. The following year she trans ferred to teach a grade 3 class. After 13 years of dedicated service to her students, Isabelle submitted her intention to retire as of June 18, 1979. May she enjoy her retirement years to the utmost.
rows.note: Heading of a narrative or list entry as printed; the quote is the first lines of the entry.

rows.quote: ALMA M. KILPATRICK - On January 1, 1963, Alma began as a teacher of grade 2 in the Elementary School to replace a teacher who had resigned. She remained on the staff until June 1964 when she resigned for family reasons. However, she returned to teaching again in September 1965 until September 1976 when she requested a leave-of-absence. In September 1977 she returned as a 2/7ths reading teacher at the Middle School.
rows.note: Heading of a narrative or list entry as printed; the quote is the first lines of the entry.

rows.quote: BARBARA H. PATCH + Barbara began in the Elementary School as a teacher of grade 5 in September 1962. In all, Barbara contributed 17 years of outstanding service to our schools. Effective June 18, 1979, she retired so that she and her husband could do some traveling. Our sincere thanks to Barbara and our best wishes for the years ahead. - 117 -
